title: Crooked Kingdom
author: Leigh Bardugo
summary: Conclusion of a two-book heist story set in a grimy, canal-crossed port city. After a job goes sour and the crew is cheated, a young criminal mastermind and his team plot a final, near-impossible reckoning.
readIf: you like a clever crew of damaged teenagers, tight plotting and double-crosses.
skipIf: you haven't read Six of Crows, since this picks up directly from its ending.

pairings.reason: The first half of this story, essential to read before this one.
An adult fantasy heist with sharp banter and a charming gang of thieves in a canal city.
Another young adult fantasy full of scheming and bruised loyalties, with a faerie setting.
